consequence.statement: Additive feature: the rules endpoint can now be filtered by rule_name, rule_group, file and type; nothing is stated to break.

original.statement: The Loki Ruler endpoint GET /prometheus/api/v1/rules gains support for filtering results by rule_name, rule_group, file and type.

decision.reason: [ev-d93690b5448d] lists this under Features. It says only that the Ruler's `/prometheus/api/v1/rules` endpoint gains optional filtering by rule_name, rule_group, file and type. Nothing in the evidence says existing behaviour changes, fails or is rejected. An operator who does nothing sees no operational effect, so kind "none" (informational) is supported, and so is severity low.
